author: Ivan Ball-llovera
name: MMCA command slice (command + handler)
description: One write-side vertical slice for an existing MMCA module: a command record wired for cache invalidation, plus its handler loading the aggregate through IUnitOfWork and returning Result. Generated into a folder named after the use case.

app.description: The solution / root namespace this slice belongs to, for example Contoso.Support.

module.description: The module this slice goes into, plural PascalCase, for example Billing.

aggregate.description: The aggregate root the handler loads, singular PascalCase, for example Invoice.

aggregateLower.description: Lower-case aggregate name: local variables and the prose in the doc comments.

useCaseNamespace.description: The use-case namespace segment. Derived from the slice name so the folder, the namespace, and the type names agree. Matching the compound 'UseCases.Delete' rather than a bare 'Delete' is what keeps the aggregate's own Delete() method call out of this rename.

domainMethod.description: The guarded method this command calls on the aggregate. Add it to your aggregate returning Result before the slice will compile.

domainMethodCall.description: The full call expression. The token has to carry the dot and the parentheses, and so does the replacement: binding the bare parameter to '.Delete()' substitutes just the method name and leaves 'aggregateDelete', which does not compile.

manualInstructions.text:
1. Add the guarded method this command calls to your aggregate, returning Result.
2. Map the command in your module's controller (writes inject handlers directly).
3. Handlers are convention-scanned by Scrutor, so there is no DI registration to add.
